🎯 3-STEP DEPLOYMENT FOR NEW RASPBERRY PI 4:
═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

STEP 1: PREPARE NEW RPi (5-10 minutes)
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  On your laptop/PC:
  
  1. Download Raspberry Pi Imager:
     https://www.raspberrypi.com/software/
  
  2. Flash Raspberry Pi OS to microSD card (64GB+)
     - Version: Raspberry Pi OS (32-bit or 64-bit)
     - Storage: Minimum 32GB (64GB recommended)
  
  3. Boot new RPi
     - Plug in power
     - Connect to network (WiFi or Ethernet recommended)
     - Wait 2-3 minutes for initialization
  
  4. Enable SSH (if not automatic)
     On new RPi terminal:
     $ sudo raspi-config
     → Interface Options → SSH → Enable
  
  5. Don't need LEXAR - just SanDisk USB


STEP 2: CONNECT & SSH (2-3 minutes)
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  On your laptop/PC:
  
  1. Insert SanDisk USB into new RPi USB port
  
  2. Find new RPi IP:
     $ nmap -sn 192.168.1.0/24  # Scan network
     OR use: https://www.raspberrypi.com/documentation/computers/remote-access/#finding-your-raspberry-pi-on-the-network
  
  3. SSH to new RPi:
     $ ssh pi@<new-rpi-ip>
     Password: raspberry (default)
  
  4. On new RPi terminal:
     $ lsblk  # Find USB (usually /dev/sda1)


STEP 3: DEPLOY (ONE COMMAND - 10-15 minutes)
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  On new RPi terminal:
  
  $ cd /mnt                   # Navigate to mount point
  $ sudo mount /dev/sda1 /mnt/usb   # Mount USB if needed
  $ cd /mnt/usb/Enhancement  # Go to Enhancement directory
  $ chmod +x rpi4-setup-complete.sh
  $ ./rpi4-setup-complete.sh  # ⭐ THIS DOES EVERYTHING!
  
  
  ⏳ WAIT 10-15 MINUTES
  
  The script automatically:
    ✓ Checks system requirements
    ✓ Installs Docker & Docker Compose
    ✓ Builds Docker image (takes 5-10 min)
    ✓ Starts application
    ✓ Verifies health
    ✓ Shows access URL
  
  
  ✅ DONE! Script will show:
     "✅ Setup Complete"
     "Dashboard URL: http://xxx.xxx.xxx.xxx:11078"


═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

STEP 4: ACCESS DASHBOARD (Immediate)
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  Open in browser:
  http://<new-rpi-ip>:11078
  
  You should see:
  ✓ Dashboard loads
  ✓ All UI elements visible
  ✓ Can add devices
  ✓ Methods/tests available
  ✓ Check Available Logs works


═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

✨ THAT'S IT! 3 STEPS, ~20 MINUTES TOTAL ✨

⚡ QUICK COMMANDS ON NEW RPI:
═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

After deployment completes:

  View logs:
    $ docker logs -f rdk-middleware-dashboard
  
  Check status:
    $ docker ps
  
  Monitor resources:
    $ docker stats rdk-middleware-dashboard
  
  Stop application:
    $ docker-compose -f docker-compose.rpi.clean.yml stop
  
  Restart:
    $ docker-compose -f docker-compose.rpi.clean.yml restart
  
  Stop & save data:
    docker-compose stop  # Data persists in volumes!


🔍 VERIFY SUCCESSFUL DEPLOYMENT:
═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  ✓ Dashboard accessible at http://<new-rpi-ip>:11078
  ✓ All pages load without errors
  ✓ Device management interface works
  ✓ Test methods available
  ✓ "Check Available Logs" shows 15 patterns
  ✓ Settings/configuration pages accessible
  ✓ No Docker error messages
  ✓ Container is healthy


🆘 TROUBLESHOOTING:
═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  "Mount failed"
    $ sudo mkdir -p /mnt/usb
    $ sudo mount /dev/sda1 /mnt/usb
  
  "Permission denied"
    $ sudo chown -R $USER /mnt/usb
  
  "Docker not found"
    Script auto-installs - this is normal
    Wait for installation to complete
  
  "Slow build"
    5-10 minutes is NORMAL on RPi!
    ARM processors compile slower
  
  "Container won't start"
    $ docker logs rdk-middleware-dashboard
    $ ./docker-verify-setup.sh


📊 SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS:
═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  Minimum:
    • RAM: 2GB
    • Storage: 32GB SD card
    • CPU: Dual-core
    • Result: Works but may be slow
  
  Recommended (BEST):
    • RAM: 4GB (RPi 4 standard)
    • Storage: 64GB SD card
    • CPU: Quad-core (RPi 4 standard)
    • Result: Good performance
  
  Optimal:
    • RAM: 8GB (RPi 4/5)
    • Storage: 128GB+ USB/SSD
    • CPU: Quad-core high clock
    • Result: Excellent performance
